alt: QUESTION 1 OF 8: Do I really pay no hosting fee? — Eligible static websites are hosted on GitHub Pages, which lets us provide hosting without charging a monthly hosting fee. Websites that need server-side processing, databases, authentication, private APIs, or dynamic backend functionality may require a different hosting solution

QUESTION 2 OF 8: Is a custom domain included? — You can use the free default GitHub Pages URL, or connect a custom domain like www.yourbusiness.com. Domain registration cost is separate from the website package unless explicitly included, and we can handle setup for an additional fee.
QUESTION 3 OF 8: What counts as a free update? — Changing text, replacing images, updating your phone number, WhatsApp number, business information, social links, or correcting small content issues.

QUESTION 4 OF 8: What doesn't count as a free update? — New pages, major redesigns, new functionality, e-commerce, booking systems, authentication, database-backed functionality, and major structural changes. These are quoted separately.

QUESTION 5 OF 8: How long does delivery take? — Timelines depend on how quickly we receive your content, but our reusable template system is built to keep delivery fast, especially for Starter and Plus websites.

QUESTION 6 OF 8: What do I need to provide? — Your business/personal details, a short description of what you do, your services, contact information, social media links, preferred colors, your logo (if you have one), and any images you'd like used.
QUESTION 7 OF 8: Can I refer people and earn money? — Yes. See the Referral Agents page for commission rates and how it works.

QUESTION 8 OF 8: What if my website needs are more complex than the standard packages? — Talk to us about the Custom package. Pricing and free-update period are agreed based on the scope of the project.
